description: This file declares functions related to managing the harvesting status, reporting period, polling period, and override TTL for neighboring access points (APs). It provides function prototypes for setting and getting these parameters, possibly for a network management or monitoring component.

methods.name: SetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status indicating if neighboring AP scans are enabled.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting interval in seconds for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling interval in seconds for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current polling period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default reporting period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default polling period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Returns the timeout in seconds after which the NAP intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout period in seconds for accelerated NAP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Returns the default timeout value for NAP scans.

methods.name: ValidateNAPPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period value is within the acceptable range for NAP scans.
